name: Sài Gòn
headline: Heat, coffee, traffic, and momentum.
subheadline: The city I keep reading in layers.
introduction: Sài Gòn is speed and softness at once: early coffee, market noise, wet streets, neon, old apartments, and the feeling that the city is always mid-sentence.
shortDescription: Coffee corners, old apartments, market noise, humid evenings, and a city rhythm that never really switches off.
description: Coffee corners, old apartments, market noise, humid evenings, and a city rhythm that never really switches off.
longDescription: The best way to photograph Sài Gòn is to stop trying to summarize it. Pick a district, walk slowly, drink something cold, and let the city reveal itself one layer at a time.
overview: A restless southern city for coffee rituals, food, street texture, old buildings, and humid evening light.
weatherNote: Dry season makes walking easier. Rainy evenings can be beautiful but sudden.
travelTips: Explore by neighborhood, not by scattered landmarks.
Start early for markets and coffee.
Keep rain plans loose in the wet season.
notFor: Travelers who need quiet, clean air, or a slow resort pace.
seoTitle: Sài Gòn Photo Notes | Coffee, Streets, and City Momentum
seoDescription: A short editorial photo note from Sài Gòn: coffee corners, old apartments, food, markets, traffic, humid evenings, and urban street photography.
